questions.text: Define Operating System. Explain OS functions and services. Differentiate between Monolithic, Layered, Microkernel, and Hybrid OS architectures with diagrams.
Explain Dual-Mode Operation (User Mode vs Kernel Mode) and privileged instructions. Explain System Calls, system call execution cycle, and context switching.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Process Management and CPU Scheduling
questions.text: Define Process and Process Control Block (PCB). Explain 5-State Process Transition Diagram (New, Ready, Running, Waiting, Terminated).

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Process Management and CPU Scheduling
questions.text: Differentiate between Process and Thread. Explain User-Level Threads (ULT) vs Kernel-Level Threads (KLT) and Multithreading Models (1:1, Many:1, Many:Many).

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Process Management and CPU Scheduling
questions.text: Explain CPU Scheduling Criteria (Throughput, Turnaround Time, Waiting Time, Response Time). Given processes with Arrival Times and Burst Times, draw Gantt Chart and calculate average waiting time for: (a) FCFS, (b) SJF / SRTF, (c) Priority Scheduling, and (d) Round Robin (Time Quantum $q=2$).
Define Critical Section Problem and Race Condition. Explain the three requirements for a valid critical section solution (Mutual Exclusion, Progress, Bounded Waiting).

Explain Semaphores (Counting Semaphore vs Binary Semaphore/Mutex). Implement solutions using Semaphores for Classical Synchronization Problems: (a) Producer-Consumer Problem, (b) Readers-Writers Problem, or (c) Dining Philosophers Problem.
Define Deadlock. Explain four necessary conditions for Deadlock (Mutual Exclusion, Hold and Wait, No Preemption, Circular Wait).

Explain Deadlock Avoidance using Dijkstra's Banker's Algorithm (Safety Algorithm and Resource-Request Algorithm). Given Allocation, Max, and Available matrices, determine if the system is in a safe state and list safe sequences.
Explain Contiguous Memory Allocation: Fixed Partitioning vs Dynamic Partitioning. Compare Placement Algorithms: First-Fit, Best-Fit, and Worst-Fit with internal and external fragmentation.
Explain Paging Hardware Architecture with Page Table and Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB). Calculate Effective Memory Access Time (EMAT) given TLB hit ratio and access times.

Define Virtual Memory and Demand Paging. Explain Page Fault handling sequence. Given a reference string and frame capacity, calculate page faults for: (a) FIFO, (b) Optimal (OPT), and (c) LRU Page Replacement algorithms. Explain Belady's Anomaly.
Explain Segmentation with hardware diagram. Compare Paging vs Segmentation.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: File Systems and Mass Storage Management
questions.text: Explain File Access Methods (Sequential, Direct/Random) and Directory Structures (Single-level, Two-level, Tree-structured, Acyclic-graph).

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: File Systems and Mass Storage Management
questions.text: Explain File Allocation Methods: Contiguous Allocation, Linked Allocation, and Indexed Allocation (UNIX Inode structure with direct, single, double, triple indirect blocks).

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: File Systems and Mass Storage Management
questions.text: Explain Disk Scheduling Algorithms: FCFS, SSTF, SCAN (Elevator), C-SCAN, LOOK, and C-LOOK. Given a cylinder request queue and initial head position, calculate total head movement.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Protection, Security and Linux System
questions.text: Explain Access Matrix model for system protection and its implementation using Access Control Lists (ACL) and Capabilities.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Protection, Security and Linux System
questions.text: Explain Linux System Architecture: Linux Kernel, Shell, Virtual File System (VFS), and process management (`fork()`, `exec()`, `wait()`).
